mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to a weak labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with weak labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion (HOUST > 600.0 thousand units), strong residential construction activity supports consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production level above 90 (INDPRO > 90) indicates strong manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 90.

mechanism_narrative: A nonfarm payrolls increase above 130,000 thousand persons signals a robust labor market that enhances consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 370000 million dollars), elevated consumer spending drives corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600.0 thousand units (HOUST > 600.0) indicates a strengthening housing market that supports consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0.
